aggregation:argmax: Deprecated name of arg_max with older column naming (max_x, max_x_y); not accepted here. Use arg_max().
aggregation:argmin: Deprecated name of arg_min; not accepted here. Use arg_min().
aggregation:hll: The sketch encoding is gokql's own: dcount_hll and hll_merge agree within the estimate, but a sketch from ADX cannot be merged here.
aggregation:tdigest: The digest encoding is gokql's own; percentile_tdigest results agree within the digest's accuracy.
aggregation:percentile: Nearest-rank, as ADX: exact on small inputs; on large inputs ADX's t-digest can differ in the last digits.
function:geo_info_from_ip_address: Not supported: needs a GeoIP database.
function:columnnamesof: Listed in Microsoft's docs index but rejected by ADX itself.
function:extenttags: Listed in Microsoft's docs index but rejected by ADX itself; use extent_tags().
function:percentile_array_tdigest: Rejected by ADX itself; use percentiles_array_tdigest().
function:external_table: No external tables: read files with externaldata.
function:database: Databases are this one and those listed in gokql.yaml; database('*') and wildcards work in union, find and search.
function:current_cluster_endpoint: The "cluster" name in gokql.yaml, default localhost.
function:cursor_after: Over _TimeReceived; null for rows without one.
function:cursor_before_or_at: Over _TimeReceived; null for rows without one.
function:extent_id: The empty guid, as the emulator answers per row.
function:hash: Agrees with ADX except for decimal inputs.
function:materialized_view: Views are always current, so max_age has nothing to bound.
function:series_periods_detect: Spectral peaks plus autocorrelation: the top period agrees with ADX, scores can differ by a few hundredths.
plugin:autocluster: Same output shape; ADX's selection is unspecified, so the segments found can differ on large inputs.
plugin:basket: Same output shape; ADX's selection is unspecified.
plugin:diffpatterns: Closed-itemset contrast: ADX's segments appear with the same counts, possibly with a few more.
plugin:diffpatterns_text: Closed positional token patterns; ADX's patterns appear, possibly with more.
plugin:http_request: Needs a webapi rule in the callout policy (guide/security.md). Can start a query.
plugin:http_request_post: Needs a webapi rule in the callout policy.
plugin:ai_embeddings: Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (azure_openai callout rule); an empty connection string uses gokql's embedder. Key from GOKQL_AI_API_KEY.
plugin:ai_chat_completion: Any OpenAI-compatible chat endpoint (azure_openai callout rule). Key from GOKQL_AI_API_KEY.
plugin:infer_storage_schema: Local files and folders, http files; csv, tsv, psv, scsv, txt, json, multijson.
plugin:python: Not implemented: would embed an interpreter.
plugin:r: Not implemented: would embed an interpreter.
plugin:sql_request: Not implemented: needs a database driver.
plugin:mysql_request: Not implemented: needs a database driver.
plugin:postgresql_request: Not implemented: needs a database driver.
operator:externaldata: Local paths, file:// and http(s) (callout policy); csv, tsv, psv, scsv, txt, json, multijson; .gz.
operator:render: Accepted; the result is returned unchanged (no charts).
operator:macro-expand: Entity groups of databases (inline or let); stored entity groups are not supported.
operator:evaluate: Can also start a query: evaluate http_request(...).
operator:reduce: Drain-style clustering with ADX's output shape; suited to log lines.
operator:graph-match: Also reachable from GQL and openCypher (guide/graphs.md).
operator:partition: All strategies run the same way on one node.
statement:Restrict: Not supported: restriction belongs to a multi-tenant service.
statement:Set: query_now, query_bin_auto_size/at and truncationmaxrecords take effect; other options are accepted.
function:assert: Evaluated per row and with any expression; ADX requires a condition that is constant at query-analysis time, so row-level validation with assert() is gokql-only.
